weeks.label: Semaine du 20 octobre 2026
weeks.headline: Earnings from RTX, CB and MSCI coincide with pre-FOMC positioning as CPI holds at 3.7% and crypto sentiment stays neutral.

themes.title: Q3 Earnings Season
themes.detail: Reports from RTX, CB and MSCI expected to drive moves in industrials and financials. CB and MSCI report after close today (20/10), RTX later this week. Results not yet published — anticipation only.

themes.title: Rates and Fed Dynamics
themes.detail: September CPI at 3.7% YoY keeps markets focused on the upcoming FOMC meeting 27-28/10. ~83% HOLD expected (Trading Economics 19/10). T10Y eased to ~5.08-5.15% vs 5.35% peak (Warsh dovish signal).

themes.title: Crypto Narratives
themes.detail: Bitcoin dominance at 59.6% and Fear & Greed index at 55 (Greed) signal balanced risk appetite. No new ETF catalyst or institutional flow change detected. Poche crypto book IA reste à 0% (F&G ≠ signal d'entrée — seuil contrarien <40).
